name: All Authority Has Been Given To Me In Heaven And On Earth
overview: The Scriptures affirm that all authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Jesus Christ, as He declares in Matthew 28:18, establishing His sovereign power over all creation. This authority is evident in His power to forgive sins and perform miracles on earth (Matthew 9:6), and it is questioned by religious leaders who recognize His unique position (Matthew 21:23). Furthermore, Jesus' words carry ultimate judgment (John 12:48), and believers are empowered to continue His works through faith (John 14:12), underscoring the divine authority entrusted to Him and extended to His followers.
